if.test: pStartDate != null and pStartDate != '' and pEndDate != null and pEndDate != ''

where.if: AND (TransStartDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND TransStartDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tOrdSlnkTrans WHERE ResultType = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOrdSlnkTrans ( StartDate, EndDate, MallCode, LoginId, ResultType, ResultMessag, FileLoc, TransStartDate, TransEndDate, ShoplinkerURL, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate ) VALUES ( #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{mallCode}, #{loginId}, #{resultType}, #{resultMessag}, #{fileLoc}, #{transStartDate}, #{transEndDate}, #{shoplinkerUrl}, 1, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() )
